questions.question: On this day in 1760, who became King of Great Britain and Ireland following the death of his grandfather?
questions.explanation: George III acceded to the British throne on 25 October 1760, succeeding his grandfather King George II.
questions.context:
On this day in 1760: George III became King of Great Britain and Ireland, succeeding his grandfather George II.
George III (King of Great Britain and Ireland from 1760 to 1820): George III was King of Great Britain and Ireland from 25 October 1760 until his death in 1820. He was concurrently duke and prince-elector of Hanover in the Holy Roman Empire before becoming King of Hanover on 12 October 1814.

questions.question: Which actor provided the voice for Clark Kent and his superhero alter ego in the 1990s animated series Superman: The Animated Series?
questions.explanation: Tim Daly voiced Clark Kent and Superman across several projects, including Superman: The Animated Series.
questions.context: Tim Daly (American actor (born 1956)): James Timothy Daly is an American actor, producer and director, best known for his roles as Joe Hackett on the NBC sitcom Wings and his recurring role as drug-addicted screenwriter J.T. Dolan on The Sopranos. He starred as Pete Wilder on the ABC medical drama Private Practice from 2007 to 2012. He is also known for his voice role as Clark Kent/Superman in Superman: The Animated Series and several animated Superman movies.

questions.question: British singer Amy Winehouse was particularly renowned for which type of vocal range?
questions.explanation: Amy Winehouse was famous for her deep, expressive contralto vocals across genres like soul, jazz, and rhythm and blues.
questions.context: Amy Winehouse (British singer-songwriter (1983–2011)): Amy Jade Winehouse was a British singer and songwriter. She is known for her distinctive contralto vocals, expressive and autobiographical songwriting, and eclectic blend of genres such as soul, rhythm and blues, and jazz. Her music, along with her fashion and highly publicised personal life, made her an influential figure in popular culture.

questions.question: What mathematical object with only one surface and one boundary edge can be created by giving a strip of paper a half-twist before joining its ends?
questions.explanation: A Möbius strip is a famous non-orientable surface with a single continuous edge, formed by connecting the ends of a strip with a half-twist.
questions.context: Möbius strip (Non-orientable surface with one edge): In mathematics, a Möbius strip, Möbius band, or Möbius loop is a surface that can be formed by attaching the ends of a strip of paper together with a half-twist. As a mathematical object, it was discovered by Johann Benedict Listing and August Ferdinand Möbius in 1858, but it had already appeared in Roman mosaics from the third century CE. The Möbius strip is a non-orientable surface, meaning that within it one cannot consistently distinguish clockwise from counterclockwise turns.

questions.question: Which television drama series starred Téa Leoni as United States Secretary of State Elizabeth McCord from 2014 to 2019?
questions.explanation: Téa Leoni portrayed former CIA analyst and US Secretary of State Elizabeth McCord in the political drama series Madam Secretary.
questions.context: Téa Leoni (American actress (born 1966)): Téa Leoni is an American actress. Early in her career, she starred on the television sitcoms Flying Blind (1992–1993) and The Naked Truth (1995–1998). Her breakthrough role was in the 1995 film Bad Boys, which led to leading parts in Deep Impact (1998), The Family Man (2000), Jurassic Park III (2001), Spanglish (2004), and Fun with Dick and Jane (2005). From 2014 to 2019, Leoni starred as Secretary of State Elizabeth McCord on the CBS drama series Madam Secretary.
